modmenu.descriptionTranslation.unified_o: Client-side performance and network optimizations. Works without the other Unified mods.
unified_optimizations.feature.fast_ip_pi: Pings servers listed by a private, LAN, Tailscale or loopback IP address without a slow reverse DNS lookup. Public IPs, hostnames and joining a server are unchanged; Mojang's blocklist still checks the IP and the typed address.
Returns to the menu while a singleplayer world finishes saving in the background. Opening, editing or deleting a world, and closing the game, wait until the save has finished.
